intitule: Describe a Restaurant Experience - Write a Paragraph

enonce.texte:
Instructions: Write a short paragraph (6-8 sentences) describing a recent restaurant experience. Use the present simple with he, she, it to describe the food, the service, and the price. Also include clothing items you wore.

Hint: Include: what you ordered, who served you, how much it cost, what you wore.

questions.texte: Write a paragraph about a restaurant experience.
questions.reponse: Example: I went to a nice restaurant with my family. The waiter serves us very well. He brings the food quickly. My sister orders fish with rice. My mother likes the chicken. The food tastes delicious. The meal costs 5,000 CFA. I wear a white shirt and black pants. It is a good experience.

intitule: Bargaining at the Market - Create a Dialogue

enonce.texte: Instructions: Create a dialogue (at least 8 exchanges) between a customer and a seller at a market. The customer wants to buy a pair of shoes and tries to bargain. Use polite expressions and ask about prices.

questions.texte: Create a dialogue at the market.
questions.reponse: Example: Customer: "Excuse me, how much are these shoes?" Seller: "They are 3,000 CFA." Customer: "That's a bit expensive. Can you give me a discount?" Seller: "For you, I can sell them for 2,500 CFA." Customer: "2,500 is still high. What about 2,000?" Seller: "OK, I agree. 2,000 CFA." Customer: "Great! I will take them. Thank you!" Seller: "You're welcome. Come again!"
